verdictScope: Semantic certification of the frozen 120-question, five-track slice only. This does not reject or certify other items, producer migration, app admission, native presentation, or full BIZQ-01 completion.

sample.method: Frozen deterministic sample; explicit seed/risk overrides are listed in SAMPLE.json. No inferential quality percentage.

sourceParity.basis: Compared each selected current content-repository source file SHA-256 to the frozen sample row.

coverageLimitations.stage: NOT_ESTABLISHED: canonical question sources have no authored stage/learningStage field; node spread is not stage stratification.
coverageLimitations.difficulty: Claude, GCP ACE, AWS SAA, Azure AZ-104, and Azure AI-901 each had only null difficulty in their 24 selected objects. Difficulty-based representation is therefore absent for these five target tracks.
coverageLimitations.sampleRepresentation: Each target track contributes 24 objects. This is a bounded review budget, not evidence of statistical representativeness or a whole-bank quality rate. The other four tracks in the frozen 216 sample are out of scope here and remain unreviewed by this report.

choiceMultipleWholeObjectReview.finding: All seven choice_multiple answer sets and every omitted_option/wrong_option message match the authored key and stated constraints. This is source semantic review; it does not establish runtime partial-credit behavior.

trackFindings.finding: 23 items PASS; one correction needed in quantitative feedback; all selected questions otherwise present concrete case decisions and aligned explanations.

24 DEFECT: repeated learner-visible exclusion/instruction constraints and recurring category-level distractors cue elimination instead of testing the stated Google Cloud decision. Six representative source-reference mismatches are individually called out in item notes; those references do not make the accepted choices wrong.
23 items PASS; one DEFECT where the keyed stored-policy propagation explanation does not account for the stem’s multi-minute successful SAS requests under current Microsoft documentation.

24 DEFECT: repeated generic authoring template gives no concrete evidence to select the keyed capability/operation for the stated vignette; constraints are meta-prompts or broad requirements and per-option feedback repeats a generic diagnosis. The broad AI-901 objective match is not enough to make the individual decision assessable.

24 reviewed: 1 PASS, 23 DEFECT. One is a prompt/constraint failure-domain conflict; several have generic or topic-mismatched feedback/Details; 21/24 keys are uniquely longest, a systematic qualitative answer-shape cue, and two of the remaining three use multiple implausible category fillers. Only the GWLB item retained two credible nearest alternatives and tied the key in length. Most keyed technical choices remain supported; defects concern assessability, alternatives, and feedback, not wholesale technical falsity.

items.reviewNote: Nearest alternative B reflects a recognizable over-assumption about managed services. limitations: This is not an admission, native iOS/Android/VoiceOver, Premium-account, end-of-session, or full BIZQ-01 verdict.
The frozen question sample and canonical item JSON establish authored content only; learner-visible constraints/UI behavior remain bounded by the existing content contract and consumer evidence.

Sample findings are exact item-level evidence. Cohort repetition may justify a broader source scan, but the 24-item review is not used to estimate the number or percentage of affected unsampled questions.

No unresolved technical claim is used as a PASS basis for the recorded critical findings; scenario-only premises are treated as explicit hypothetical facts where they are not contradicted by the key/source.

auditMethodCorrection.cause: The initial AWS issue notes were copied from a preliminary list without matching each description back to its exact whole-object questionId and fingerprint. Two topic diagnoses were crossed between N18-B05-003 (predictive scaling) and N17-B06-018 (storage-capacity rehearsal). The prior 18 generic PASS notes also did not record nearest-alternative or option-shape assessment.
auditMethodCorrection.correctiveMethod: Re-read all 24 frozen AWS objects in sample order. For each row, check questionId and fingerprint, compare prompt/constraints/all options/key/Reason/all Details/all option messages, then write that row’s finding immediately. Separately counted authored key versus distractor lengths solely to document the existing qualitative §4.3 pattern; assessed the closest alternatives item by item and did not apply an automatic cutoff. Recomputed totals from actual per-item statuses.
auditMethodCorrection.scope: AWS sample only; no other track notes or source objects were changed.

awsStyleObservation.scope: AWS SAA 24 selected whole items only
awsStyleObservation.interpretation: Twenty-one keyed choices are uniquely longest; many combine multiple favorable clauses while wrong choices are shorter, single-error absolutes or unrelated categories. This is evidence of a systematic answer-shape cue under §4.3, not an equal-length rule, automatic length threshold, or claim that each keyed technical conclusion is false. The remaining three were separately judged by distractor plausibility; two had multiple implausible category options, while the GWLB item retained two relevant near-miss alternatives despite one unrelated filler.
